name: Java Refactor Pack
purpose: Plan or execute safe Java-focused refactoring for maintainability, structure, and testability improvement.
when_to_use: a Java class is too large or mixed in responsibility
duplication should be reduced without changing behavior
structural cleanup is the main task
notes: Add domain.spring if the class is framework-managed or transactional.
Prefer incremental transformations with clear behavior-preservation checks.
Do not mix broad rewrite ambitions into a local refactor unless explicitly requested.
